_comment: TEMPLATE, INTENTIONALLY ALREADY EXPIRED. Every rate below is a placeholder (0.0), and 'expires' is set in the past on purpose so cost.py's own loader refuses to compute anything until you replace these values — that refusal is the intended first-run experience, not a bug. Verify every rate against https://www.anthropic.com/pricing, then set verified/expires/source/provenance for real.

notes.tool_system_overhead_tokens: Tool-enabled requests may carry a fixed system-prompt overhead. Confirm the current figure on the tool-use docs page, then fill.
notes.region_us_only: Some providers report a premium for region-restricted routing against the global default. Confirm on the pricing page, then fill.
notes.long_context_threshold_tokens: Some models surcharge above a context threshold. Confirm per model on the pricing page, then fill.
notes.cache_min_tokens: Omit the key for any model whose minimum is neither documented nor measured; a guess must never be readable as fact.
